notes.title: Luster 1.1 version Update
notes.notes:
Unfamiliar with the adult game review mechanism at the beginning, and made the following changes based on relevant comments in player reviews:

 Remove all cover on CG
 Change the way the mouse moves the element to drag
 Make the last level easy

This is our first attempt at an adult game.
The unfamiliarity with the censorship mechanism and the conservative content of the game make the player's initial gaming experience unpleasant, 
Thank you very much for playing the game!
